title: Hello, C
bridge: C programs start in `int main(void)`, and `printf("...\n");` prints. Unlike `cout` or `print`, `printf` uses **format codes** to slot values in: `printf("%d kg\n", 40);`. Statements end with `;`, blocks use `{ }`, and the whole file is compiled first.

exercises.title: Hello from C
hints: Don't forget the \n and the semicolon.

exercises.title: Formats
exercises.prompt:
Using printf with format codes (not typing the numbers into the text), print:
7 bags of maize
price 55.50

tests.why: Use %.2f to show exactly 2 decimal places.

quiz.q: Which format code prints an int?
Does printf add a new line by itself?

cards.q: Print an int, a double (2 places), a string?

explain: Explain hello, c to someone who has never programmed, in your own words, with an example you make up.
